title: Callvale after: a role for the application
claim: The application gets role credentials on the instance, people sign in with MFA, and the root user has no access key.
alt: After: an instance profile passes an IAM role to the EC2 instance. The application gets temporary credentials from the instance metadata and calls Amazon S3 and Amazon Transcribe. Ana and Ben sign in as IAM users with MFA in two groups. The root user has MFA and no access key.

edges.label: instance profile
edges.say: The instance profile passes the IAM role to the EC2 instance.

edges.label: temp credentials
edges.say: The application gets temporary credentials for the role from the instance metadata.

edges.label: role credentials
edges.say: The application calls Amazon S3 and Amazon Transcribe with the temporary credentials.

edges.label: MFA sign-in
edges.say: Ana and Ben sign in as IAM users with MFA, in two groups.

edges.label: MFA
edges.say: The root user has MFA and no access key.

notes: Brief 03, story picture. Placement: 2-deep.md#decision-record, after Decision. Same cells as iam-before (A1, B1, group A4:B4, B4, A5, B5); the MFA device takes B2, where the root access key was. No IAM role sends credentials: the instance profile passes the role and the instance metadata delivers the credentials (exemplar README mistake 10). Step facts: iam-instance-profile-one-role-and-metadata-credentials, iam-ec2-role-credentials-rotate-automatically. No AWS number or limit in the drawing.
